raw.commentary: Causal integrity fails across plots with and-then links and invented enables (Morpheus 018->020, Society 018->019->023). Perspective generally holds but Morpheus borrows Cypher's stance and Neo retells objective action. Membership is padded (Morpheus ev-020) and missing core beats (Neo missing ev-022, Morpheus missing ev-013). Arcs are complete for Neo/Relationship/Society but Morpheus lacks vindication and Crew ends on escalation not resolution. Heavy event reuse across all five plots drives non-redundancy to 2.
